\label{lemma-tensor-with-complex-homotopy}
The functor of Lemma \ref{lemma-tensor-with-complex} defines an exact functor
of triangulated categories
$K(\text{Mod}_{(E, \text{d})}) \to K(\mathcal{O})$.
review_scope: pinned Stacks source and surrounding conventions; proofs not reviewed
statement:
Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be a ringed site and $K^\bullet$ a complex of $\mathcal O$-modules. Here $(E,\mathrm d)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\operatorname{Comp}^{dg}(\mathcal O)}(K^\bullet,K^\bullet)$ is the differential graded endomorphism algebra of $K^\bullet$.

The dg functor $M\mapsto M\otimes_E K^\bullet$ from $\operatorname{Mod}^{dg}_{(E,\mathrm d)}$ to $\operatorname{Comp}^{dg}(\mathcal O)$ defines an exact functor
of triangulated categories
$K(\text{Mod}_{(E, \text{d})}) \to K(\mathcal{O})$.
hypotheses: (C,O) is a ringed site; K is an O-module complex; E is its dg endomorphism algebra.
conclusions: The dg functor M↦M⊗_E K induces an exact triangulated functor from K(Mod_E) to K(O).

\label{lemma-tensor-with-complex-derived}
The functor $K(\text{Mod}_{(E, \text{d})}) \to K(\mathcal{O})$
of Lemma \ref{lemma-tensor-with-complex-homotopy} has a left derived
version defined on all of $D(E, \text{d})$. We denote it
$- \otimes_E^\mathbf{L} K^\bullet : D(E, \text{d}) \to D(\mathcal{O})$.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-upgrade-tensor-with-complex-derived}
Let $R$ be a ring. Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site. Let $\mathcal{O}$
be a sheaf of commutative $R$-algebras. Let $K^\bullet$
be a complex of $\mathcal{O}$-modules.
The functor
of Lemma \ref{lemma-tensor-with-complex-derived} has the following
property: For every $M$, $N$ in $D(E, \text{d})$ there is a
canonical map
$$
R\Hom(M, N)
\longrightarrow
R\Hom_\mathcal{O}(M \otimes_E^\mathbf{L} K^\bullet,
N \otimes_E^\mathbf{L} K^\bullet)
$$
in $D(R)$ which on cohomology modules gives the maps
$$
\Ext^n_{D(E, \text{d})}(M, N) \to
\Ext^n_{D(\mathcal{O})}
(M \otimes_E^\mathbf{L} K^\bullet, N \otimes_E^\mathbf{L} K^\bullet)
$$
induced by the functor $- \otimes_E^\mathbf{L} K^\bullet$.

Let $R$ be a ring. Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site. Let $\mathcal{O}$
be a sheaf of commutative $R$-algebras. Let $K^\bullet$
be a complex of $\mathcal{O}$-modules.
The derived tensor functor $-\otimes_E^{\mathbf L}K^\bullet:D(E,\mathrm d)\to D(\mathcal O)$ has the following
property: For every $M$, $N$ in $D(E, \text{d})$ there is a
canonical map
$$
R\Hom(M, N)
\longrightarrow
R\Hom_\mathcal{O}(M \otimes_E^\mathbf{L} K^\bullet,
N \otimes_E^\mathbf{L} K^\bullet)
$$
in $D(R)$ which on cohomology modules gives the maps
$$
\Ext^n_{D(E, \text{d})}(M, N) \to
\Ext^n_{D(\mathcal{O})}
(M \otimes_E^\mathbf{L} K^\bullet, N \otimes_E^\mathbf{L} K^\bullet)
$$
induced by the functor $- \otimes_E^\mathbf{L} K^\bullet$.
hypotheses: R is a commutative unital ring, C a site, O a sheaf of commutative R-algebras, K an O-complex, E its dg endomorphism algebra; M and N are objects of D(E).
conclusions: There is a canonical derived-Hom comparison map in D(R) from RHom_E(M,N) to RHom_O(M⊗_E^L K,N⊗_E^L K), inducing the Ext maps of derived tensor.

\label{lemma-tensor-with-complex-hom-adjoint}
Let $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$ be a ringed site.
Let $K^\bullet$ be a complex of $\mathcal{O}$-modules.
Then the functor
$$
- \otimes_E^\mathbf{L} K^\bullet :
D(E, \text{d})
\longrightarrow
D(\mathcal{O})
$$
of Lemma \ref{lemma-tensor-with-complex-derived} is a left adjoint
of the functor
$$
R\Hom(K^\bullet, -) : D(\mathcal{O}) \longrightarrow D(E, \text{d})
$$
of Lemma \ref{lemma-existence-of-derived}.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-fully-faithful-in-compact-case}
Let $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$ be a ringed site.
Let $K^\bullet$ be a complex of $\mathcal{O}$-modules.
Assume
\begin{enumerate}
\item $K^\bullet$ represents a compact object of $D(\mathcal{O})$, and
\item $E = \Hom_{\text{Comp}^{dg}(\mathcal{O})}(K^\bullet, K^\bullet)$
computes the ext groups of $K^\bullet$ in $D(\mathcal{O})$.
\end{enumerate}
Then the functor
$$
- \otimes_E^\mathbf{L} K^\bullet :
D(E, \text{d})
\longrightarrow
D(\mathcal{O})
$$
of Lemma \ref{lemma-tensor-with-complex-derived} is fully faithful.

statement:
Let $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$ be a ringed site.
Let $K^\bullet$ be a complex of $\mathcal{O}$-modules.
Assume
\begin{enumerate}
\item $K^\bullet$ represents a compact object of $D(\mathcal{O})$, and
\item $E = \Hom_{\text{Comp}^{dg}(\mathcal{O})}(K^\bullet, K^\bullet)$
induces isomorphisms $H^n(E)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O)}(K^\bullet,K^\bullet[n])$ for all integers $n$.
\end{enumerate}
Then the functor
$$
- \otimes_E^\mathbf{L} K^\bullet :
D(E, \text{d})
\longrightarrow
D(\mathcal{O})
$$ is fully faithful.
hypotheses: (C,O) is a ringed site; K is compact in D(O); E is its dg endomorphism algebra and H^n(E) agrees with Hom_D(O)(K,K[n]) for each n.
conclusions: The derived tensor functor -⊗_E^L K:D(E)→D(O) is fully faithful.
